translation: Cóż… W zamian za milczenie chciałbym coś dostać.

source_text: Don’t even think about it.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Don’t even think about it.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Don’t even think about it."

source_text: I want a free ham every time I come to visit!

structure.raw_value: SiFlEx^.I want a free ham every time I come to visit!
structure.script_literal: "SiFlEx^.I want a free ham every time I come to visit!"

translation: Chcę darmową szynkę za każdym razem, gdy tu przyjdę!

source_text: But… we don’t have ham.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.But… we don’t have ham.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.But… we don’t have ham."

source_text: Uhh… We do have ham. And I’m sure we can hook up this fine gentleman.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.Uhh… We do have ham. And I’m sure we can hook up this fine gentleman.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.Uhh… We do have ham. And I’m sure we can hook up this fine gentleman."

translation: Eee… Mamy szynkę. Na pewno coś dla tego miłego pana znajdziemy.

source_text: Yes! You all have the best ham! See you tomorrow for lunch!

structure.raw_value: SiHaAg^.Yes! You all have the best ham! See you tomorrow for lunch!
structure.script_literal: "SiHaAg^.Yes! You all have the best ham! See you tomorrow for lunch!"

translation: Tak! Macie najlepszą szynkę! Do zobaczenia jutro na lunchu!

source_text: What is he talking about?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.What is he talking about?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.What is he talking about?"

source_text: You know that rat we saw in your apartment?

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.You know that rat we saw in your apartment?
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.You know that rat we saw in your apartment?"

translation: Pamiętasz tego szczura, którego widzieliśmy w twoim mieszkaniu?

source_text: I cooked it and made… ‘’ham’’ with it.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.I cooked it and made… ‘’ham’’ with it.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.I cooked it and made… ‘’ham’’ with it."

translation: Przyrządziłem go i zrobiłem z niego… „szynkę”.

source_text: Looks like the dinner crowd is starting… I better get back to work.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp.Looks like the dinner crowd is starting… I better get back to work.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp.Looks like the dinner crowd is starting… I better get back to work."

translation: Zaraz zacznie się wieczorny ruch… Lepiej wracam do pracy.

source_text: You can do it, Judy. I believe in you.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You can do it, Judy. I believe in you.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You can do it, Judy. I believe in you."

translation: Dasz radę, Judy. Wierzę w ciebie.

source_text: Thanks for lunch, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp.Thanks for lunch, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp.Thanks for lunch, 1Hero."
